title: Project: wiring routes, service and repository end to end

objectives.text: Pass the repository into a service and the service into Javalin handlers through constructors
Register GET and POST routes whose handlers call the service and return JSON
Trace a request from route through handler and service to repository and back, and make the in-process public tests pass with mvn -q -o test
